exposure: Hospital type (RSON-supported hospitals vs. referral hospitals)
outcome: Proportion of childbearing people who resided in RSON communities and gave birth locally
cohort: The study included 18,270 childbearing people (3498 from RSON-supported hospitals and 14,772 from referral hospitals) in British Columbia, restricted to singleton births between 2016 and 2021.
finding: Childbearing people who gave birth at RSON-supported hospitals had a 10% lower incidence of adverse maternal-newborn outcomes compared to those who gave birth at referral hospitals, after controlling for referral bias.
